summary: Basal DH 0-5 cm (6 mm, 1F) under FC 4 mm 5-26 cm (1F), a 13 cm laminated-crust stack at 26-39 cm (three P MFcl layers, 3 mm, alternating with three thin K IF layers at 30-31, 33-35 and 37-39 cm), FC 2 mm 39-67 cm (1F-), a buried 8 mm rounding SH layer at 67 cm (2x CT11 SP), FC 0.5 mm 67-93 cm (1F) and DF 0.5 mm 93-104 cm (F); HS 104 cm; snow -0.7 C at the ground, coldest -5.2 C at 70 cm, -0.4 C at the surface
reading_issues: Hardness bars, boundaries and temperature dots were measured from native pixels (HS line at y=157, ground at y=751 give 5.71 px/cm; hardness ticks every 24 px = 1/3 step); boundaries rounded to integer cm (measured within 0.2 cm). The six thin layers at 26-39 cm have stretched form-table rows with connector lines; rows were matched to layers by order (11 layers, 11 rows). Glyphs: '=' (double bar) on the K layers read as IF (ice formation/crust); three clustered circles read as MFcl (MF); slash read as DF. The 'SH sz8 rounding' comment applies to the 67 cm failure interface, but no SH layer is drawn in the layer table (FC above and below), so layer_grain SH comes from the comment only; the failure sits at the boundary of the 39-67 and 67-93 cm FC layers. '2x' is recorded as count 2. Temperature dots at 0, 10, 20, ... 90, 94 and 104 cm (104 = snow surface, -0.4 C; header air temperature is -0.7 C). Aspect S is as printed even though the slope is 0 deg (flat study plot).
